depth_charts.depth_chart_policy: Club-published 'Unofficial Depth Chart'. Every NFL club's own site publishes one; NFL.com's own depth-chart route returns 404 (verified).

meta.method_note: Depth position is read from the club's own published depth chart. Because only 4 of 32 club charts were transcribed and verified, 2nd/3rd/4th-string detail is only asserted for KC, GB, NE and DET. Everywhere else the field is null and the row is flagged.
meta.why_index_is_not_points: There is no official source that converts a depth-chart slot into expected points. The index above is a stated, auditable weighting used only to sort clubs. It must not be read as a point-spread adjustment.

personnel_verification.name: Every position-group key is unique within its side
No player appears twice at different depths of the SAME position group
7 players are legitimately listed at two different positions (real charts do this; each is declared, not merged away)

personnel_verification.name: Every row marked 'mapped' carries a depth position
Every row carries one of the three declared map statuses
Every club with injury rows appears in the coverage table
No depth position is asserted for a club whose chart was not transcribed
Starter/2nd/3rd/4th-string counts equal a fresh recount of the rows
12 injured players are explicitly flagged as absent from their club's published chart (not silently treated as backups)
